text: 2021 Rate Supported Budget Launch, with presentations from City Officials on the following: - Toronto Water - 2021 Staff Recommended Operating Budget and 2021-2030 Staff Recommended Capital Budget and Plan - Solid Waste Management Services - 2021 Staff Recommended Operating Budget and 2021-2030 Staff Recommended Capital Budget and Plan - Toronto Parking Authority - 2021 Staff Recommended Operating Budget and 2021-2030 Staff Recommended Capital Budget and Plan Presentation materials will be posted on November 6, 2020 online at toronto.ca/council.
